verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Card Expenses API built for this purpose: it retrieves approved card expenses and marks them as synced once ingested into an ERP or accounting system (airwallex-docs-4). The Spend product also claims reconciliation of company spend (airwallex-docs-30). However, this is an API the finance team must build against rather than an automatic, out-of-the-box sync with accounting software, and it covers only card expenses. missing for 10: native accounting-software connectors (e.g., Xero/QuickBooks/NetSuite), automatic sync of broader transactions beyond card expenses, independent or hands-on corroboration.
